said.q: Willem de Kooning’s Woman series stands as one of the pillars of post-war American art, and the present Woman drawing, executed in 1952, is one of his earliest and most expressive iterations on paper. The series was begun in earnest in June of 1950, and de Kooning struggled with the first mature masterpiece, the canvas Woman I, now in the permanent collection of the Museum of Modern Art, New York, for two years, finally completing it in the same year that this mesmerizing drawing was realized.
